jobs.done_note: CUTPOINTS-END ok=1 exact=33/33 max_mad=2.83 by tick-C2133. First run of this job used ffmpeg scene scores as the gate and returned 12/33 - that was a detector limit, not a trim defect: every detected edge sat within 0.11s of an expected window edge, and scene scores simply do not fire between visually similar shots (they also fire on intra-shot motion). v2 replaces the proxy with an exact test: for each of the 33 units, the conform frame at mid-window is pixel-compared (mean abs diff) against the same frame of its own source clip, searching +-4 frames to absorb the constant ~0.1s offset the render carries (total landed 196.25s vs 196.14s expected). All 33 units matched at MAD<=2.83 (limit 6.0, i.e. JPEG-free encode noise only). Scene scores stay in the receipt as supporting evidence.
